title: The Missing Ficus
missing_item: Large communal ficus (potted office plant) — pot cracked and plant relocated
setting: Open-plan marketing office with kitchenette and copy room

timeline.event: Staff arrive; the ficus sits in its usual spot near the kitchenette.
Morning stand-up meeting in the conference area.
Someone in the office is seen near the plant with a watering can.
A loud crack is heard from the kitchenette area; pot is later found cracked.
The ficus is no longer in its usual spot; soil and water are found on the floor.
Office manager notices the plant missing and asks around; staff give statements.

shared_facts: The communal ficus pot was in its usual place near the kitchenette at arrival.
By 10:00 the pot was cracked and the plant was not in the usual spot; soil and water were on the floor.
No one reported authorizing removal of the plant.
The office cleaning crew had not been in before 10:15.
The kitchenette camera is out of order and provides no footage for the morning.

solution.motive: Embarrassment and fear of blame after causing accidental damage; moved the plant to hide the accident.
solution.true_story: Riya Patel accidentally overwatered the communal ficus while trying to revive a drooping leaf. The saturated soil made the pot unstable; it slipped and cracked against the cabinet edge. Panicked and embarrassed about breaking a shared office item, Riya moved the plant behind the copy room and pretended not to know where it was.

suspects.name: Mark Liu
suspects.public_persona: Desktop support specialist; meticulous, often jokes about keeping things 'by the book'.
suspects.alibi: At my desk the whole morning fixing a network issue; I stepped away only to grab a sandwich at 11:30.
private_knowledge: Around 09:35 I saw Riya Patel (suspect_3) near the plant carrying a small watering can.
I noticed damp footprints leading away from the kitchenette toward the copy room around 09:50.

relationships.suspect_2: Sits two rows over; we chat about schedules.
relationships.suspect_3: Works on the same floor; she waters plants sometimes.
relationships.suspect_4: We coordinate when machines need reboots.

suspects.behavior_rules: Will stay calm and factual; volunteers times and observations but avoids speculation.

suspects.name: Olivia Park
suspects.public_persona: HR coordinator; organized and approachable, often mediates small disputes.
suspects.alibi: In HR calls from 09:00–09:50, then briefly in the kitchenette at about 10:05 getting coffee.
private_knowledge: I saw fresh soil smudges on the floor near the kitchenette when I walked through at 10:05.
I noticed the ficus was not in its spot when I went by to make coffee.

relationships.suspect_1: Gets IT help from Mark sometimes.
relationships.suspect_3: Checks in with Riya about office welfare occasionally.
relationships.suspect_4: Handles perks that Ethan asks about (e.g., team lunches).

suspects.behavior_rules: Polite and by-the-book; repeats her alibi and points out visible signs like soil without naming a suspect unless asked.

suspects.name: Riya Patel
suspects.public_persona: Graphic designer who keeps several small plants on her desk; friendly but private about mistakes.
suspects.alibi: I was at my workstation working on a tight deadline. I handled the ficus this morning because it looked droopy.
private_knowledge: I tried to revive a sad-looking leaf and overwatered the ficus around 09:40; the pot slipped and cracked.
I moved the plant behind the copy room because I panicked and didn't want my mistake to interrupt the office.

relationships.suspect_1: Mark occasionally helps me with my computer when files won't load.
relationships.suspect_2: Olivia asked me once about office greenery; friendly but not close.
relationships.suspect_4: Know Ethan by sight; we say hello in the kitchen.

suspects.behavior_rules: Nervous and embarrassed; may volunteer too much detail if pressured, becomes defensive when accused directly but will admit when confronted with clear, cross-referenced observations.

suspects.name: Ethan Brooks
suspects.public_persona: Sales lead; outgoing and often in and out for client visits.
suspects.alibi: I left the office briefly at 09:30 to drop off a package and returned by 09:55; I was on calls after 10:00.
private_knowledge: When I returned around 09:55 I noticed the plant area looked disturbed and there was damp soil trailing toward the copy room.
Riya usually waters that plant; I've seen her doing it several times.

relationships.suspect_1: Mark fixed my laptop last month; we trade quick tech tips.
relationships.suspect_2: Olivia organizes our team training sessions.
relationships.suspect_3: Riya waters the ficus regularly; we chat in the kitchen.

suspects.behavior_rules: Energetic and talkative; offers observational details but may downplay responsibility for noticing earlier.
